headline: Researcher & Engineering Educator | AI/ML for Wireless Networks
summary: Electrical and Computer Engineering researcher and educator with a PhD from the University of Oklahoma specializing in AI/ML for wireless networks. Research addresses reliable learning, propagation modeling, network optimization, self-healing, digital twins, generative augmentation, and reinforcement learning for 5G/6G systems. University teaching and research are complemented by industrial R&D at AT&T Labs, Futurewei, and AT&T, bridging rigorous experiments with real-world network challenges.
researchInterests: Propagation Modeling and Wireless Digital Twins

skills.Wireless & Networked Systems: LTE/4G, 5G-NR, NTN, mobility, RAN, propagation modeling, outage management, self-healing, network measurements, and service assurance
skills.Research Methods: Experimental design, 3GPP-aligned simulation, statistical analysis, cross-validation, reproducible workflows, distribution-shift evaluation, technical writing, and publication development
skills.Engineering Tools: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, cloud analytics, data pipelines, visualization, Git, and Linux
skills.Teaching & Mentoring: Wireless communications, communication systems, programming, machine learning, laboratory instruction, experimental methods, student projects, and research development

dissertationFocus: Doctoral research in AI/ML for wireless networks, emphasizing resilient propagation models, data-efficient generative learning, adaptive network optimization, self-healing, and reproducible evaluation.
